usage: config <command> [args]
       config <git-command> [args]

Commands:
  build          Build every workspace crate and install its stamped binary
  deps           Check or install the dependencies the manifest names
  doctor         Report installed binaries that do not match their source
  help           List the config subcommands and what each one does
  init           Finish a fresh clone: git config, hooks, dependencies, binary
  install        Install the dependencies the manifest names
  install-hooks  Link the git hooks and put the dispatcher on PATH
  reload         Reload the tmux config and print the line to re-source zsh
  stamp          Print the build stamp of each workspace crate
  test           Run the test suite, optionally in Docker or in a watch loop

Run `config <command> --help` for the flags a command takes.

Any other verb is passed to git on the bare repo at ~/.cfg, so every
git command works: config status, config add <path>, config commit.
